links.surface: الْحاكِمُ أَبُو عَلِيِّ الحُسَيْنُ بْنُ أحْمَد الْبِيْهَقِيُّ

notes: «سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الحَسَنِ عَلِىَّ بْنَ مِيْثَم» is a link by rule 5; Ibn Maytham tells the story, so he is the last link
«الْحاكِمُ» is the laqab in front of the name and stays in the surface
The poems and the Suli's notes appended after the story are not routes (rule 4); the Imam Musa and the Imam al-Rida named inside the story are in the scene only

levels.surface: الحاكم أبو علي الحسين بن أحمد البيهقي

notes: «2 -» is the leading report number, left out
«سمعت أبا الحسن علي بن ميثم» is rule 5 («سمع X» is a link): Ibn Maytham is the last link, since the story and the saying are his account
The Imam al-Rida is a subject of the story (the mother's purchase and naming), not a transmitter, so he is not a link (rule 6)
Later «قال الصولي» remarks, «وقد روى قوم» (an unnamed group on the mother's name) and the poem's note are remarks inside the matn, not routes, and are not written as groups
